name: comp-31
title: Overlapping Label Input
blurb: Email input with label overlapping the top border.
description: An email input with a label positioned absolutely at the top, using negative translate and background to appear overlapped. No floating animation.
use_when: Compact forms where the label should always be visible but space-efficient.
avoid_when: You need the label to animate in/out (this is static positioning).
a11y: Label is linked to input via htmlFor. Responds to disabled state via group-has-disabled.
